p='index.html'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
start=s.index("canvas.addEventListener('click'")
end=s.index("// Starter village", start)
new="canvas.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!selected||dragging)return;let [x,y]=invIso(e.clientX,e.clientY);if(x<-12||x>14||y<-9||y>13)return;if(buildings.some(b=>b.x===x&&b.y===y))return;let cost=costs[selected];if(coins<cost){document.getElementById('tip').textContent='Недостатньо монет';document.getElementById('tip').classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('tip').classList.remove('show'),1800);return;}coins-=cost;buildings.push({x,y,type:selected});if(['house','tower','villa','mosque'].includes(selected)){people+=selected==='villa'?8:selected==='house'?4:3;}happiness=Math.min(100,happiness+(['garden','mosque'].includes(selected)?6:selected==='market'?5:3));updateUI();});\n"
s=s[:start]+new+s[end:].replace("[[ -3,-1,'house'],[-1,-1,'house'],[1,-1,'house'],[-2,1,'market'],[1,1,'well'],[3,0,'garden'],[3,3,'house']]", "[[ -3,-1,'house'],[-1,-1,'villa'],[1,-1,'tower'],[-2,1,'market'],[1,1,'well'],[3,0,'garden'],[3,3,'house'],[-5,3,'workshop'],[-4,-4,'mosque']]")

PY
